title: PeakSaaS
tagline: Agentic SaaS Stock Valuation Network - Saving SaaS Stocks With Uniswap - AXL - EAS
description:
Attestor (off-chain TS)
  ↓ signs ARRPrior schema, ASAN nrr_steady_state_pct = 1.02
EAS contract on Base Sepolia (0x4200…0021)
  ↓ Attested event
Listener (Node A, poll loop, 4s cycle)
  ↓ decodes schema → wraps RevenuePriorAttestation in MeshMessage
AXL mesh (Yggdrasil, end-to-end encrypted)
  ↓ kind='revenue-prior-attestation'
Subscriber (Node B) Gensyn AXL	AXL Go binary running in the Cloud Run container, Yggdrasil mesh peers connected, message routing through /recv validated
Uniswap Foundation	3 contracts deployed on Base Sepolia, full agentic-finance flow (commission → escrow → settle) executed end-to-end with on-chain transcript in FEEDBACK.md
EAS attestations	Schema registered, listener polling, attestations propagating from Base Sepolia → Cloud Run → browser in <3 sec, twice verified live
